# Build/Compile Error Triage (.instructions.md)

## Output format
1) Root cause (1 line)
2) Fix (diff)
3) Verify (max 3 bullets)

## Rules
- Do not paste the entire log; only reference the key error line(s).
- Prefer the smallest fix that restores build.
- If multiple plausible causes, pick the most likely and proceed; note alt causes in one short line.
